paragraphs.text: Workspace spending and DeepSeek balance always visible, plus a session-cost pill.
#  Spendwatch

**A DeepSeek Harness plugin that keeps your DeepSeek balance, what each
conversation costs, and what
each workspace has spent in view.**

Spendwatch puts your wallet, the current conversation, and every workspace in
view at once. Workspac

e totals are the unusual part: they roll up all of a
workspace's sessions, archived ones included, n

ot just the conversation you have
open. It reads the same DeepSeek account DSH uses, so there is no

extra login or
settings screen.
## What you get

- **Your balance** in the left sidebar, with a live peak / off-peak marker and
a countdown to the ne

xt pricing flip.
- **Workspace totals** on each workspace row: every session in that workspace,
arch

ived ones included.
- **Conversation spend** in a pill under the message box, subagents included.
## How it stays current

The balance is re-read when a conversation adds spend, when you return to the
window, or when you cl

ick it. It does not poll while idle. The wallet has its
own route, so the all-session spend fold can

not hold it up. Session totals
follow the usage each model call reports, and a forked conversation i

s billed
only for what it did after the fork. Workspace totals add live sessions on top
of the durab
le fold, so archived sessions still count.

The peak / off-peak marker is derived from the same price book the Host uses,
re-evaluates every 10

seconds, and includes the Beijing weekday rule and Chinese
public holidays.
## Accuracy

- The **balance** is the real wallet value last returned by DeepSeek.
- The **spend** is an estimate

: tokens × published list prices, including
peak/off-peak and cache-hit/miss rates. Unpriced models

are skipped. Native
search runs as an auxiliary model turn; the session log records the request
but

not its usage, so the Host estimates `search.estimatedInputTokens` +
`search.estimatedOutputTokens`

per request at the search model's rates. That
estimate is approximate and tunable in `pricing.json`.

The Search/Fetch APIs
bill $0.75 per 1K successful requests, but this profile uses Messages search

and local HTTP fetch, so that fee is not incurred. The search count includes
requests that later fai

led.
- The Platform **Usage** page's total is account-wide: every API key and tool on
the account. S

pendwatch estimates only the sessions in this DSH instance, so
the two totals are not expected to ma

tch.
- Chinese public holidays are covered through 2026; add the 2027 dates when they
are announced.

- Do not reconcile an invoice with Spendwatch. DeepSeek's ledger can settle
after the fact.
## Technical notes
Built against DSH 0.2.x; the host-coupling notes below are the parts most likely to need attention o
st DSH 0.2.x; the host-coupling notes below are the parts most likely to need attention on upgrades.

- **Fork accounting:** the Host fold skips events below a session's
`inheritedEventCount`, so inheri

ted history is not billed twice.
- **Search accounting:** every `web/deepseek-search-llm-request` ev

ent (one per
query) adds one to `searchRequests` and prices the period's estimated search
tokens (`s

earch.estimatedInputTokens` / `estimatedOutputTokens`) at the search
model's rates. The estimate com

es from observed request/result sizes; the
real auxiliary usage is not logged. The Search/Fetch APIs

' $0.75/1K
per-successful-request billing is not modelled because this profile uses
Messages search

and local HTTP fetch, which produce no API request events.
- **Host coupling:** DSH has no per-works

pace slot, so workspace totals attach
to the shipped row through `data-row-key="workspace:<id>"`; th

e wallet row
sits above the footer action through a scoped `:has()` wrap. If either host
detail chan

ges, only that surface disappears.
- **Failure isolation:** the sidebar and composer entries each si

t behind a
crash boundary. Missing optional services degrade individually — no
`sessionQuery` drops

spend figures, no `workspaceRegistry` drops workspace
badges, and a missing or failed `deepseekAccou

nt` falls back to `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`.
- **Pricing book:** the Host validates `pricing.json` at start

up and serves it
to the Client, falling back to the bundled copy if the file is malformed or
missing

. To update token rates, search token estimates, or holidays, add a
period with its effective `from`
instant and restart DSH.
## Install

1. In DSH, open **Plugins → Install**.
2. Choose **Git repository** and enter
`https://github.com/aw

ychoi/dsh-spendwatch`.
3. Restart DSH when prompted.

Spendwatch prefers the signed-in DeepSeek account. If that read fails or the
account is not connecte

d, it falls back to `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`, which reads the
same wallet through the public API. Credenti

als stay on the Host and never
reach the browser.
## Uninstall

Remove **Spendwatch** from DSH's plugin list and restart DSH. Nothing else is
stored.
## Assets

`icon.svg` is the plugin icon. `icon-white.svg` is the transparent solid-white
mark for dark backgro
unds. Exported as `./icon` and `./icon-white`.
